Horaires de l'écluse Saint-Félix (Erdre) gérée par le Département. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are ouvrage d'art, canal de navigation, voie navigable. The portal shows 6 records. The portal shows 2025-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
